stories.title: NVIDIA 考虑为 Nscale 西弗吉尼亚 AI 数据中心贷款作担保
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，面对投资者对 AI 支出的紧张情绪，NVIDIA 正权衡为 Nscale 在西弗吉尼亚的 AI 数据中心项目贷款提供共同签署担保。芯片供应商参与融资担保，可能成为支撑数据中心扩张的新方式。
stories.analysis: 这反映 AI 基建热潮正把芯片厂商推向金融角色，风险与客户绑定更深。
stories.sourceExcerpt: When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan.

stories.title: Sam Altman：内存放在数据中心比放在个人电脑更合理
stories.sourceTitle: Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your desk
stories.summary: 在 Cheeky Pint 播客中，Sam Altman 被问及内存短缺时表示，把 RAM 留在个人 PC 而不是数据中心是“糟糕的”。这表达了 OpenAI 对 AI 算力资源优先级的立场。
stories.analysis: 算力需求正挤压消费级硬件供应，AI 数据中心获得资源优先级。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it's "terrible" to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers. During his appearance on the Cheeky Pint podcast, where he also commented on

stories.sourceTitle: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
stories.summary: 据报道，OpenAI、Google、Microsoft 和 Anthropic 将采用一项新标准，让出版商可表达不被 AI 抓取的偏好，并跨平台应用 AI 训练偏好。
stories.analysis: 内容授权争议从个案谈判转向标准化退出机制，但执行与范围仍是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable. With this control, publishers can apply their AI training preferences across

stories.title: Google 卫星 AI 服务器首次从太空回传响应
stories.sourceTitle: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
stories.summary: Google 表示已成功启动卫星上的 TPU，让星载 Gemma 4 模型执行提示并生成首个来自太空的响应。这验证了把 AI 算力放到轨道的早期可行性。
stories.analysis: 太空数据中心从概念走向在轨推理，但带宽、能源和维护仍是长期约束。

stories.title: Apple Intelligence 将随 iOS 27.3 登陆中国
stories.sourceTitle: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
stories.summary: Apple 在其中国新闻室宣布，Apple Intelligence 将随 iOS 27.3 进入中国，首批功能会在 11 月 4 日推出的 iOS 27.3 测试版中提供。
stories.analysis: 中国版落地意味着 Apple 需在本地合规与模型合作上找到平衡。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website, as reported by MacRumors. The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that's set to launch on November 4th, with

stories.title: 星巴克拟在得来速用 AI 展示个性化数字菜单
stories.sourceTitle: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru
stories.summary: 星巴克 CEO Brian Niccol 在财报电话会上表示，公司将探索在顾客驶入得来速时识别参与客户，并展示个性化数字菜单的体验。
stories.analysis: 餐饮零售正把 AI 用于会员识别和点单转化，隐私与体验一致性是落地难点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Starbucks could eventually show you a personalized digital menu when you pull up to the drive-thru. During an earnings call on Thursday, Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said the company is going to explore "experiences that recognize participating customers as they

stories.title: 隐私优先 AI 助手 Ollie 将在约一周后关停
stories.sourceTitle: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
stories.summary: Ollie 创始人表示，这款强调尊重用户隐私的 AI 助手将在约一周后停止服务，背景是 AI 助手市场竞争日益拥挤。
stories.analysis: 隐私卖点难单独支撑助手产品，分发与模型能力仍是生存门槛。
stories.sourceExcerpt: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.

stories.title: Intel 股价大跌，美国政府持股缩水 120 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，AI 行业大量消耗内存等零部件推高 PC 价格、拖累 PC 销售，Intel 股价随之大跌，美国政府所持股份价值减少 120 亿美元。
stories.analysis: AI 基建对供应链的挤压正外溢到 PC 市场和政府投资组合。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Intel is being hurt by PC sales as the AI industry gobbles memory and other components causing PC prices to rise.

stories.title: FT：Anthropic 预计在 IPO 后获信用机构高收益“垃圾”评级
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
stories.summary: 据 FT 报道，Anthropic 在 IPO 后预计会被信用评级机构给出高收益级“垃圾”评级，这可能提高其融资难度和成本。
stories.analysis: 高评级成本会考验 Anthropic 以巨额支出来维持增长的融资模式。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business.

stories.title: 科技极客的最后一分钟万圣节装扮：AI Agent 图标、PHP 漏洞等
stories.sourceTitle: Last-minute Halloween costumes for tech nerds
stories.summary: TechCrunch 盘点了适合科技极客的临时万圣节装扮，包括 AI Agent 图标、PHP 漏洞和“困倦的 Bryan Johnson”等创意。
stories.analysis: 这类轻内容反映 AI 文化符号已进入大众玩笑和节日消费。
stories.sourceExcerpt: No Halloween costume? Just be a deceptively cute AI agent icon, a PHP vulnerability, or sleepy time Bryan Johnson.

stories.title: Google 首个数据中心卫星上线，正在写“蹩脚”诗歌
stories.sourceTitle: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
stories.summary: Google 首颗搭载 TPU 的数据中心卫星已上线，运行 Google DeepMind 的 Gemma 4 模型并生成了一段略带俗套的诗歌。
stories.analysis: 这是太空 AI 推理的演示性里程碑，距离商业化数据中心仍有距离。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The first TPU in space is running a Google DeepMind Gemma 4 model and writing cheesy poetry.

stories.title: AI 支出热潮出现裂缝：债务上升、现金流为负、投资者怀疑加剧
stories.sourceTitle: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
stories.summary: TechCrunch 指出，大型科技公司正投入数十亿美元建设 AI 基础设施，但债务上升、负现金流和投资者怀疑正在引发对这轮支出可持续性的质疑。
stories.analysis: 资本开支从“军备竞赛”转向回报审视，融资环境将决定扩张节奏。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Big Tech is pouring billions into AI infrastructure, but mounting debt, negative cash flow, and growing investor skepticism are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom.

stories.title: 硅谷想让你投资“奇迹”：AI 风险与估值如何定价
stories.sourceTitle: Silicon Valley wants you to invest in miracles
stories.summary: The Verge 讨论投资 AI 股票为何像押注公司未来，尤其当这项技术可能带来灾难性或存在性风险时，投资逻辑变得更复杂。
stories.analysis: AI 投资叙事把高回报与高尾部风险捆绑，估值需要纳入治理与监管不确定性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Investing in any stock is kind of like gambling in the sense that you're betting your money on a company's future performance. But how do you bet on a technology that could, in the worst-case scenario, "pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity," or b

stories.title: Sam Altman 同情数学家，但称 OpenAI 的数学成果攻势不会停
stories.sourceTitle: Sam Altman sympathizes with mathematicians, but says OpenAI’s math onslaught won’t stop
stories.summary: 面对数学界被大量 AI 生成结果冲击，Sam Altman 表示同情研究者的困惑，但明确 OpenAI 不会停止，并暗示未来还会有更多成果。
stories.analysis: AI 正在改变数学研究的产出与验证方式，学界需要新的同行评审和归因机制。
stories.sourceExcerpt: After months of bombarding mathematicians with a relentless stream of AI-generated results, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says he sympathizes with researchers struggling to make sense of it all. But he has no intention of stopping - and hints there could be much more

stories.title: 缅因州数据中心抗议或决定参议院控制权归属
stories.sourceTitle: Maine’s data center revolt will decide who controls the Senate
stories.summary: The Verge 报道，缅因州参议员 Susan Collins 在辩论中被观众打断，抗议者称 AI 数据中心正在破坏气候并污染水源，数据中心争议正成为中期选举议题。
stories.analysis: AI 基建的本地环境成本正转化为选举政治，项目审批将更受社区抵制影响。

stories.title: Zest 推出 AI 代理：通过短信综合口味、投票并预订餐厅
stories.sourceTitle: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
stories.summary: Zest 的新 AI 礼宾服务可在短信中汇总同行者的口味偏好、让餐厅选项投票，并完成预订，解决“去哪吃”的分歧。
stories.analysis: 代理式 AI 正从信息查询走向代用户执行交易，商家接口和确认机制是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Can't agree on where to eat? Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.

stories.title: 教皇利奥十四世呼吁解除 AI 武装：机器是工具，不是人
stories.sourceTitle: Pope Leo calls for the disarmament of AI: ‘Machines are tools, not persons’
stories.summary: 教皇利奥十四世在周五的教皇讲话中表示，AI 系统应被“解除武装”，人类有责任引导、改变并在必要时拒绝其应用，并呼吁联合国成员国采取具体步骤。
stories.analysis: 宗教权威加入 AI 治理讨论，强调人类主体性与武器化风险。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Pope Leo XIV says AI systems should be "disarmed," adding that humans "have the responsibility to guide, change and, when necessary, reject its applications." In Friday's Papal Address, Pope Leo encourages United Nations member states to "take concrete steps t

stories.title: Theranos 举报人 Tyler Shultz：AI 热潮是“欺骗他人的绝佳机会”
stories.sourceTitle: Theranos whistleblower Tyler Shultz warns that the AI boom is ‘a great opportunity to go deceive people’
stories.summary: Theranos 举报人 Tyler Shultz 警告，AI 热潮可能重演误导投资者的风险，尤其是尚未盈利的公司正以万亿美元估值融资。
stories.analysis: 历史欺诈案例提醒，AI 叙事越热，尽调与可验证指标越重要。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The cautionary Theranos tale takes on a new significance in the AI era, when companies that have never turned a profit are raising capital at trillion-dollar valuations.

stories.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 将用 Braindate 安排高效人脉对接

stories.analysis: 线下创投活动正在用匹配工具提升连接效率，但核心仍是参会者质量。

stories.title: DoorDash：来自 AI 代理的订单目前仅“数百单”
stories.sourceTitle: DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents
stories.summary: DoorDash 表示，平台目前只收到“数百”来自 AI 代理的订单，但仍愿意与第三方代理开发商合作。
stories.analysis: 代理电商仍处早期，支付、账户授权和商家体验尚未规模化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: DoorDash said that it is open to working with third-party agent makers.

stories.title: 维基媒体基金会：糟糕的 AI 版权裁决可能威胁开放网络
stories.sourceTitle: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
stories.summary: 维基媒体基金会在多起标志性 AI 版权案中主张中间路线：应合法保护大语言模型对版权作品的学习训练，但不应允许聊天机器人向用户原样复现这些作品。
stories.analysis: 训练与输出被区分对待，可能成为 AI 版权责任划分的关键框架。

stories.title: OpenAI 发布社区安全报告，并加强对青少年的保护
stories.sourceTitle: Community safety report and new protections for teens
stories.summary: OpenAI 表示正在通过扩展防护措施、更早干预以及新的公共安全报告承诺，加强 ChatGPT 的暴力预防和对青少年的保护。
stories.analysis: 平台安全从内容过滤延伸到未成年人保护和透明报告，监管压力下的常规动作。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

stories.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 倒计时 5 天：门票优惠与免费第二通行证
stories.sourceTitle: 5 days left: Your last chance to connect, scale, and save at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
stories.summary: TechCrunch 提醒 Founder Summit 2026 距离开幕还有 5 天，参会者可节省最高 100 美元，并获得一张免费第二通行证。
stories.analysis: 这是活动推广信息，反映 AI 创投活动仍在争夺创业者注意力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 5 days to save up to $100, plus a second pass for free to TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 in Boston on November 4. Register now.

stories.title: Runware 建厂试图像造车一样批量生产 AI 数据中心
stories.sourceTitle: Can AI data centers be mass-produced like cars? This startup aims to find out
stories.summary: Runware 正在建设工厂，用流水线生产预制化 AI 数据中心，真正的考验是能否以该规模交付。
stories.analysis: 模块化制造可能缓解数据中心建设瓶颈，但供应链和现场集成决定成败。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Runware is building a factory to turn out prefabricated AI data centers on an assembly line. The real test will be whether it can deliver at that scale.

stories.title: OpenAI 将遵守共享 robots.txt 信号，方便网站表达 AI 训练偏好
stories.sourceTitle: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
stories.summary: OpenAI 表示将遵守一项共享的 robots.txt 信号，帮助网站运营者向参与该机制的提供商传达 AI 训练偏好。
stories.analysis: 这是对出版商关切的标准化回应，但“参与提供商”范围和执行力仍待观察。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

stories.title: 终于不是 AI 了：Lambda 直接运行 Express，API Gateway 还需要吗？
